command.name: security key-manager external aws restore
command.description: This command retrieves and restores any unrestored keys associated with the given Vserver to each node's internal key tables.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the Vserver to which the missing keys will be restored.

example.p: The following command restores missing keys for the data Vserver v1 (which has AWSKMS enabled) to the internal key tables on each node in the cluster.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external aws restore -vserver v1
